Sam G: Quick sync: we need a compact, auditable rollout plan for tenant routing change. Constraints: per-tenant immediate opt-out, don't A/B on enterprise, clear abort gates.
Marta L: Draft plan below. 3-step canary: internal -> partner opt-in -> phased slices. Keep change only in routing layer. Ops must be able to toggle per-tenant via CLI and console.
Indra K: Add shadowing during partner opt-in to compare outputs without impacting users. If quality_delta > 1.0% on billing prompts, pause.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: suggested window 2026-04-15 02:00 UTC. Auto-abort if service_error_rate >= 2.5% OR p95_latency_increase >= 35ms sustained 10m.
Priya S: CS asks: console toggle + API for immediate flip; documentation for opt-out; list of partner tenants consenting. Also want 24h rollback promise for enterprise and contact list in runbook.
Marta L: Compact runbook sketch:
- Preflight: smoke tests, partner tenant list, dashboard links
- Phase 0: internal smoke (1% internal) 10m
- Phase 1: partner opt-in (3-7 tenants), shadow + 15m OR 1k samples
- Phase 2: phased ramp slices (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 20-30m holds
- Emergency soft-kill: `routing override --target m-small --reason "rollback"`
- Rollback: `/ops rollback routing_v2` + CS notify
Indra K: Metrics: service_error_rate_pct, p95_latency_ms, quality_regression_pct (eval harness), token_cost_delta_pct. Abort if any exceed threshold for 10m. I will run automated diff reports to #eng-ml.
CS-Maya: I'll gather partner beta tenants and confirm staging keys. We'll run an opt-out verification checklist during partner opt-in.
Priya S: I'll draft partner-facing copy and console banner. Include opt-out steps and SLA language.
Marta L: I'll open infra PR for flag `routing_v2_tenant` with `force_off` per-tenant. Link to runbook when ready.
Sam G: Decisions before Wed: final numeric thresholds and who can authorize rollback. Proposal: Marta or oncall-sre can hit rollback; manual rollforward after rollback needs explicit sign-off.
deploy-bot: Guardrail config: sample_target=1500 per phase OR min_time=15m; abort rules wired into CI job.
Sam G: Schedule runbook walkthrough Wed 15:00 UTC. Keep updates here and drop links when available. :thumbsup:
